title: Refund of the Downside Protection Fee When Booked Gallons Are Released
content:
Where a booking on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts was sold with downside protection and the gallons are released without that protection ever having paid out, the fee it was sold at is refunded per gallon. Whether the protection has already paid out on the account decides how much comes back.

1. Where the programme carries downside protection and no protection credit has ever been worked out on the account, the protection refund per gallon is the programme's protection fee per gallon in full.
2. Where the programme carries downside protection and 1 or more protection credits have been worked out on the account, the protection refund per gallon is the programme's protection fee per gallon taken at a share of 0.5, carried to four decimal places.
3. Where the programme carries no downside protection, nothing is refunded per gallon for downside protection.

## Reading the lines

The count is of protection credits worked out on the account over its whole life, not over a window. Whether the programme carries protection at all, and the fee it is sold at, are written in the catalogue for the programme the account sits on.

| The programme | Protection credits ever worked out on the account | Refund per gallon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Carries downside protection | None | The programme's protection fee per gallon |
| Carries downside protection | 1 or more | Half that fee, at a share of 0.5, to four decimal places |
| Carries no downside protection | Either way | Nothing |

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose protection fee is 0.12 USD per gallon, an account on which no protection credit has ever been worked out is refunded 0.1200 USD per gallon. An account carrying one such credit is refunded 0.0600 USD per gallon. On a programme carrying no protection, nothing comes back whatever the history.
